verdict.rationale: stagewise is a standalone desktop agentic IDE with built-in agent chat sessions. In that chat you can @mention files and browser tabs, select UI elements as context, and use slash commands, so you get contextual help inside the IDE itself. missing for 10: evidence of chatting with the assistant inside an existing third-party editor such as VS Code (the GitHub integration only covers viewing and applying changes), and independent hands-on corroboration of the chat experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I can chat with the coding assistant directly inside my IDE for contextual help

citations.quote: stagewise is a standalone desktop IDE where AI coding agents can read, write, and modify files across your workspaces.
Each agent has its own chat session and can use a different model.
Type / in the chat to see available commands from your skills and plugins.
@mention files — Attach a workspace file so the agent reads it immediately.
Click on elements to attach them as agent context
